sentences.zh: 我不太清楚自己想要什么，也不清楚自己是谁，因为我总是为了迎合这些人，为了满足他们的需求，或者为了弥补他们没给我的东西，而改变自己。

sentences.en: And so then when I was single, I really had to kind of go back and figure out who I was, what I wanted and what I enjoyed just by myself.
sentences.zh: 所以当我单身时，我真的不得不回过头来，去弄清楚我是谁，我想要什么，以及我独自一人时喜欢做什么。

sentences.en: Like, first, that, first things first, I don't think you can know who your identity is in a relationship until you understand who that identity is.
sentences.zh: 首先，最重要的一点是，我觉得在一段关系中，如果你不了解自己的身份，你就无法知道自己在关系中的定位。

sentences.en: As our Lord and Savior RuPaul says, if you don't love yourself, how the hell are you going to love somebody else?
sentences.zh: 正如我们的救世主鲁保罗所说，如果你不爱自己，你又怎么可能爱别人呢？

sentences.en: And I didn't love myself.
sentences.zh: 而我当时并不爱自己。

sentences.en: I didn't have that.
sentences.zh: 我没有那种自我认同。

sentences.en: And it took a really long time to build that up and, you know, your friends is a really big part of that.
sentences.zh: 建立这种认同花了我很长时间，你知道的，朋友在其中扮演了非常重要的角色。

sentences.en: Having, being able to be comfortable on your own is a really big part of that.
sentences.zh: 能够享受独处的时光也是其中非常重要的一部分。

sentences.en: And in those three years, I had so much fun, like, the best time.
sentences.zh: 在那三年里，我过得非常开心，真的是最棒的时光。

sentences.en: And kind of what you were saying before, that for a good chunk of that time, it was dating for the story.
sentences.zh: 就像你之前说的，那段时间里，很大一部分时间我都是为了故事而约会。

sentences.en: It was dating for fun and just living life and realizing things, as Kylie Jenner said in 2016.
sentences.zh: 为了好玩而约会，享受生活，去发现一些事情，正如凯莉·詹娜在2016年所说的那样。

sentences.en: Wow, flashback.
sentences.zh: 哇，回忆杀。

sentences.en: She has her, she has her, her sources.
sentences.zh: 她有她的，她有她的，她的消息来源。

sentences.en: Yeah, she has her references.
sentences.zh: 是啊，她有她的参考资料。

sentences.en: Reference.
sentences.zh: 参考资料。

sentences.en: 2016 et al.
sentences.zh: 2016年及以后。

sentences.en: You can check that.
sentences.zh: 你可以去查证一下。

sentences.en: Actually, I saw the video the other day and that is the year.
sentences.zh: 其实我前几天刚看了那个视频，确实是那一年。

sentences.en: And in that time, I experienced so many new things.
sentences.zh: 在那段时间里，我体验了许多新鲜事物。

sentences.en: I, like, literally changed my sexuality in that time.
sentences.zh: 我，甚至在那段时间改变了我的性取向。

sentences.en: Like, I experimented with girls and realized that, hey, oh, do you know what?
sentences.zh: 我尝试和女生交往，然后意识到，嘿，你知道吗？

sentences.en: It's probably a bit weird to continue scissoring your Barbies at 16 years old.
sentences.zh: 16岁还在玩芭比娃娃剪纸游戏可能有点奇怪。

sentences.en: But, just kidding, I wasn't doing that.
sentences.zh: 不过开个玩笑，我没做过那种事。

sentences.en: But I would always kind of feel like that, be like, oh, like, do I like girls?
sentences.zh: 但我总是会有那种感觉，心想，哦，我是不是喜欢女生？

sentences.en: I was like, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，我不知道。

sentences.en: Like, I could kiss them.
sentences.zh: 比如，我可以亲吻她们。

sentences.en: And I'm like, oh, you're gay.
sentences.zh: 然后我就想，哦，原来你是同性恋。

sentences.en: Like, come on.
sentences.zh: 得了吧。

sentences.en: Like, you're trying to convince yourself.
sentences.zh: 你是在试图说服自己。

sentences.en: And then you finally gave yourself the freedom to be like, let me embrace this with no label.
sentences.zh: 然后你终于给了自己自由，心想，让我不带标签地拥抱这一切吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so then I think when I got to the point that I was like, okay, this is me.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得当我意识到，好吧，这就是我的时候。

sentences.en: Like, I know what my identity is because it's so hard if you don't know what that is to not mold yourself to the person that you start dating.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你不知道自己是谁，就很难不为了开始约会的人而改变自己。

sentences.en: And you start molding yourself to their likes and their dislikes.
sentences.zh: 你开始为了迎合他们的喜好而改变自己。

sentences.en: And it's so important to keep your likes and dislikes, even if that's not compatible to the other person.
sentences.zh: 保持自己的喜好非常重要，即使这与对方不兼容。

sentences.en: So, I think what was different about, you know, this relationship that I'm in now was that I had the confidence to just be myself.
sentences.zh: 所以，我觉得我现在这段关系的不同之处在于，我有自信做真实的自己。

sentences.en: I had the confidence to be like, well, if you don't like it, that's fine because I like me.
sentences.zh: 我有自信心想，好吧，如果你不喜欢，那没关系，因为我喜欢我自己。

sentences.en: And you don't want to date someone that doesn't like you.
sentences.zh: 而且你也不想和不喜欢你的人约会。

sentences.en: Like, there's so often – I once had a boyfriend turn around to me and say, yeah, I love you, just sometimes I don't like you.
sentences.zh: 这种情况太常见了——我曾经有个男朋友转过头对我说，是的，我爱你，只是有时候我不喜欢你。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: And I laughed.
sentences.zh: 我当时笑了。

sentences.en: Like, I thought it was funny.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这很有趣。

sentences.en: And now I look back and I'm like, that was really mean.
sentences.zh: 现在回想起来，我觉得那真的很刻薄。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: That was cruel.
sentences.zh: 那太残忍了。

sentences.en: Well, Al and I were having this conversation yesterday about how that is a real trope in relationships.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我和Al昨天还在讨论，这在恋爱关系中是一个很典型的桥段。

sentences.en: Like, guys being like, oh, like, we've got the – you know, I'm out with the boys, like, free of the ball on chain.
sentences.zh: 比如男生会说，哦，我们有——你知道，我和兄弟们出去玩，就像从枷锁中解脱了一样。

sentences.en: Or, you know, like, people speak about their partners like that.
sentences.zh: 或者，你知道，人们就是那样谈论他们的伴侣。

sentences.en: And it's like, no, you should actually like each other and there should be joy there.
sentences.zh: 但其实不该这样，你们应该真心喜欢彼此，关系中应该有快乐。

sentences.en: And you should want to spend time with them.
sentences.zh: 而且你应该想要和他们共度时光。

sentences.en: It's weird.
sentences.zh: 这很奇怪。

sentences.en: That is so weird to me.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说太奇怪了。

sentences.en: And I think that it's honestly a hard thing to learn your own worth, especially having been through experiences like that.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，学会认识自己的价值确实很难，尤其是经历过那样的事情之后。

sentences.en: Like, I know that I have as well.
sentences.zh: 我知道我也经历过。

sentences.en: This person that I dated, like, probably two years ago, I became a completely different person for them.
sentences.zh: 我大概两年前约会过的那个人，我为了他变成了一个完全不同的人。

sentences.en: I sacrificed friendships for that person and I regret it all the time.
sentences.zh: 我为了那个人牺牲了友谊，我一直为此感到后悔。

sentences.en: Like, I still to this day, I don't think about him much except for the choices that I would definitely not make again.
sentences.zh: 直到今天，我除了想到那些我绝对不会再做的选择之外，很少想起他。

sentences.en: And it's interesting because then recently I had a very similar incident, like a very similar experience with someone where they – the exact same situation happened.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，最近我遇到了一个非常相似的情况，和某人经历了非常相似的体验，他们——发生了完全一样的事情。

sentences.en: And I remember sitting there and being like, I have two choices here.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时坐在那里，心想，我面前有两个选择。

sentences.en: Do I do the thing that I've done before?
sentences.zh: 我是要重蹈覆辙吗？

sentences.en: Do I make that mistake again?
sentences.zh: 我要再犯同样的错误吗？

sentences.en: Or I've learnt this lesson.
sentences.zh: 还是说我已经吸取了教训。

sentences.en: Let's go the other way.
sentences.zh: 让我们换个方式吧。

sentences.en: And I went the other way.
sentences.zh: 于是我选择了另一种方式。

sentences.en: And I think that that's a big part of how relationships can also form you as they teach you these important lessons that then you can take to not just your next relationship,
sentences.zh: 我认为这也是恋爱关系塑造你的一部分，因为它们教会你重要的课程，然后你可以把这些带到下一段关系中，

sentences.en: but your friendships and your morals and your values.
sentences.zh: 不仅是关系，还有你的友谊、道德和价值观。

sentences.en: I do want to quickly ask you a question because I'm fascinated by this.
sentences.zh: 我想快速问你一个问题，因为我对此很着迷。

sentences.en: I don't – like, I genuinely am because I imagined the person I was dating when I was, like, in my teen years.
sentences.zh: 我不是——我是真心好奇，因为我回想起了我十几岁时约会的那个人。

sentences.en: And I saw this TikTok the other day and it was like, would you rather still be working your first job or would you rather still be with the person you were dating when you were 17?
sentences.zh: 前几天我看到一个TikTok视频，上面写着：你愿意继续做你的第一份工作，还是愿意继续和你17岁时约会的人在一起？

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: I said – I totally was like, Boost Juice, I'm coming back.
sentences.zh: 我说——我完全是那种，Boost Juice，我回来了。

sentences.en: Like, I'm going to be making those Mango Magics for the rest of my life.
sentences.zh: 我这辈子都要去卖那些芒果魔力果汁了。

sentences.en: Taylor's Patisserie, give me those cinnamon donuts again.
sentences.zh: Taylor's Patisserie，再给我那些肉桂甜甜圈吧。

sentences.en: I'm down.
sentences.zh: 我愿意。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Those both sound like great choices.
sentences.zh: 那两个听起来都是不错的选择。

sentences.en: Also, Boost Juice, amazing.
sentences.zh: 而且，Boost Juice，太棒了。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: Can I get a Tropical Crush, please?
sentences.zh: 请给我来一杯热带风暴，好吗？

sentences.en: A Mango Magic, please?
sentences.zh: 请给我来一杯芒果魔力，好吗？

sentences.en: Oh, my goodness.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: No, neither.
sentences.zh: 不，都不选。

sentences.en: I'm out of office.
sentences.zh: 我下班了。

sentences.en: But I guess the question is, what has that been like for you?
sentences.zh: 但我想问题是，这对你来说是什么样的体验？

sentences.en: And I know that you've gotten a lot of – sometimes people have said to you, like, don't you wish you had tried a few more – tried before you buy or tried a few more people or,
sentences.zh: 我知道你听过很多——有时人们会对你说，难道你不希望多尝试几次吗？先试后买，或者多尝试几个人，或者，

sentences.en: like, gone out there and had that single girl era that you were just talking about, Al?
sentences.zh: 像你刚才说的，去经历那个单身女孩时代，Al？

sentences.en: And what would be your response to that?
sentences.zh: 你会怎么回应呢？

sentences.en: So, I think at first I really did question if that was something that I should be doing and was like, oh, like, am I – I've always been happy in my relationship.
sentences.zh: 所以，我觉得起初我确实质疑过这是否是我应该做的事情，心想，哦，我是不是——我在恋爱中一直很幸福。

sentences.en: But questions like that made me wonder if – is it just because this is all I've known?
sentences.zh: 但这样的问题让我怀疑，这只是因为我只经历过这些吗？

sentences.en: Do I need to go out and explore something else?
sentences.zh: 我需要出去探索别的东西吗？

sentences.en: But I think the response that I give people now is that over the last 15 years,
sentences.zh: 但我现在给人们的回应是，在过去的15年里，

sentences.en: there's never been one time where I've interacted with anyone that made me even question my relationship or tempted me.
sentences.zh: 从来没有一次，我和任何人的互动让我质疑过我的关系，或者让我动摇过。

sentences.en: Excuse me.
sentences.zh: 不好意思。

sentences.en: I'm sitting right here.
sentences.zh: 我就坐在这儿呢。

sentences.en: Aside from you, Al.
sentences.zh: 除了你，Al。

sentences.en: You're the one outlier.
sentences.zh: 你是唯一的例外。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: But, yeah, I just, like – I just try to listen to my gut and, like, what I want to do.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，我只是——我只是试着听从我的直觉，去做我想做的事。

sentences.en: I'm the sort of person that if you tell me to do something, I'll probably just do the exact opposite out of spite.
sentences.zh: 我是那种如果你告诉我该做什么，我可能会出于逆反心理去做完全相反事情的人。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我不知道。

sentences.en: I was like, what, and be like you guys?
sentences.zh: 我当时想，什么，要变得像你们一样吗？

sentences.en: Like, it doesn't really seem like any of my friends were having heaps of fun during that stage.
sentences.zh: 好像我的朋友们在那个阶段并没有玩得特别开心。

sentences.en: Do you know what I mean, though?
sentences.zh: 你知道我的意思吗？

sentences.en: We were not.
sentences.zh: 我们没有。

sentences.en: We are not.
sentences.zh: 我们真的没有。

sentences.en: Well, no, but not you guys specifically.
sentences.zh: 嗯，不，不是指你们特别。

sentences.en: I mean the people that were asking me those questions.
sentences.zh: 我是指那些问我这些问题的人。

sentences.en: Because a lot of the time when that's getting projected on you, I think it is maybe coming from a place of insecurity in some instances.
sentences.zh: 因为很多时候，当这种想法投射到你身上时，我认为在某些情况下，这可能源于一种不安全感。

sentences.en: Totally.
sentences.zh: 完全同意。

sentences.en: Yeah, but don't you want to be single?
sentences.zh: 是啊，但你难道不想单身吗？

sentences.en: Because that might be a little bit of more of them reaching for a bit of comfortability being like, yeah, but it's good to be single.
sentences.zh: 因为那可能更多是他们寻求一点安慰，心想，是啊，但单身挺好的。

sentences.en: It's good.
sentences.zh: 挺好的。

sentences.en: Like, I'm enjoying this.
sentences.zh: 比如，我很享受现在这样。

sentences.en: So, that reassurance that is like, oh, but I'm good for being in this position.
sentences.zh: 所以那种安慰就是，哦，但我处于这个位置也很好。

sentences.en: That maybe looking at someone, it is when you are single, you look at people in relationships.
sentences.zh: 这可能是在看别人，当你单身时，你会看那些处于恋爱关系中的人。

sentences.en: And sometimes you are like, oh, thank God I'm not in a relationship.
sentences.zh: 有时你会想，哦，谢天谢地我没在谈恋爱。

sentences.en: Like, I can do all this fun stuff.
sentences.zh: 我可以做所有这些有趣的事情。

sentences.en: I can do whatever I want to do.
sentences.zh: 我可以做任何我想做的事。

sentences.en: And then sometimes you are like, that would be nice.
sentences.zh: 然后有时你又会想，那应该也不错。

sentences.en: And I think what is so, the way that you and Chris and like, well,
sentences.zh: 我觉得非常——你和Chris的方式，还有，嗯，

sentences.en: I feel like I've learned from you guys as well now in a new relationship is that you only have so much energy to give in life.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我现在也从你们身上学到了，在一段新的关系中，你一生中能付出的精力是有限的。

sentences.en: And that's got to be split across work, friends, your own time, your hobbies, and then you add a partner into that.
sentences.zh: 这必须分配在工作、朋友、你自己的时间、你的爱好上，然后你再加入一个伴侣。

sentences.en: And so, you've only got like 100% of a tank.
sentences.zh: 所以，你的能量槽只有100%。

sentences.en: So, if you're splitting that, you know, 25% against across like work, friends, your own time, and then your hobbies, you've then got to take that time away from something.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你把这25%分配给工作、朋友、自己的时间，还有爱好，你就必须从某处抽走时间。

sentences.en: And because you need to obviously invest time in a relationship, but what can often happen is people pull all of that 25%, that's split across everything,
sentences.zh: 因为你需要投入时间在一段关系中，但通常发生的情况是，人们把那分配给所有事情的25%全部抽走，

sentences.en: and they put 100% into that relationship.
sentences.zh: 然后把100%都投入到了那段关系中。

sentences.en: And that's a mistake that I'd made in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 那是我过去犯过的错误。

sentences.en: And that's something that I've never seen you do, Sal.
sentences.zh: 而那是Sal你从来没做过的事情。

sentences.en: And like, the way that it's been so important, and it's an effort to do, because when you do meet someone that you really like, and you do enter that relationship,
sentences.zh: 而且，这非常重要，也需要努力去做，因为当你遇到一个真正喜欢的人，并进入那段关系时，

sentences.en: you are the most smitten kitten.
sentences.zh: 你就像一只最迷人的小猫。

sentences.en: You're like, I'm obsessed with this person.
sentences.zh: 你会想，我迷死这个人了。

sentences.en: I want to smell their neck every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都想闻他们的脖子。

sentences.en: Like, literally, I'm like, oh, that's good stuff.
sentences.zh: 真的，我心想，哦，那感觉真好。

sentences.en: The pheromones.
sentences.zh: 费洛蒙。

sentences.en: Oh, my God, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪，是的。

sentences.en: And like, you are obsessed with them, and that's so good.
sentences.zh: 而且，你对他们着迷，这太好了。

sentences.en: Like, keep that.
sentences.zh: 比如，保持那种状态。

sentences.en: But be obsessed with them in like moderation.
sentences.zh: 但要适度地沉迷于对方。

sentences.en: Have nights away from each other.
sentences.zh: 要留出彼此分开的夜晚。

sentences.en: Have those moments that, like, you allow yourselves to miss each other a little bit.
sentences.zh: 要创造一些时刻，让自己稍微想念一下对方。

sentences.en: And it's so important that you don't pull all the, like, reserve energy in other tanks and put it into that one, because what happens if that doesn't work out?
sentences.zh: 而且非常重要的一点是，不要把所有储备的精力都抽出来投入到那一段关系中，因为如果那段关系没成，该怎么办呢？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I totally, oh, no, keep going.
sentences.zh: 我完全同意，哦不，你继续说。

sentences.en: Oh, but I was just, and like, I think as well, communicating and holding down the fort on your wants, your enjoyments, on what you had when you were single is really important.
sentences.zh: 哦，我只是想说，我觉得沟通，并且坚持你自己的需求、爱好，保持你单身时拥有的那些东西，真的非常重要。

sentences.en: Like, we talk about this all the time on Two Broke Cheeks, but I love a smutty fairy book.
sentences.zh: 就像我们在《Two Broke Cheeks》里经常聊的那样，我超爱那种带点色情色彩的言情小说。

sentences.en: Like, it's just my happy place in my little fantasy land with two enemies to lovers.
sentences.zh: 那是我的快乐源泉，让我沉浸在两个死对头终成眷属的奇幻小世界里。

sentences.en: And it's just the best trope ever.
sentences.zh: 那绝对是史上最棒的桥段。

sentences.en: And like, we went on holidays, and maybe for like two or three hours of the day, we'd just go and do our own thing.
sentences.zh: 比如我们去度假时，每天大概会有两三个小时，我们会各自做自己的事情。

sentences.en: Like, we weren't spending the whole day together, because I'd want to go read my book for like an hour, or maybe go for a walk.
sentences.zh: 我们不会整天黏在一起，因为我想花一小时看书，或者去散散步。

sentences.en: Or he'd want to go, like, do something.
sentences.zh: 或者他想去干点别的什么。

sentences.en: I don't know what boys do in their own time.
sentences.zh: 我不知道男孩子自己待着的时候都在干嘛。

sentences.en: He's like a big YouTube watcher.
sentences.zh: 他是个超级YouTube迷。

sentences.en: So he would like, just want to go watch YouTube, and just like, turn off for a bit like that.
sentences.zh: 所以他可能就想去看YouTube，像那样彻底放松一下。

sentences.en: And we would just go spend time on our own, doing our own wants.
sentences.zh: 我们就会各自花时间做自己想做的事。

sentences.en: Or whenever there's a thing, like, I'm like, oh, yeah, I'm going to go stay at sales.
sentences.zh: 或者每当有活动时，我说，哦，好啊，我要去参加那个活动。

sentences.en: He's just like, okay.
sentences.zh: 他只会说，好的。

sentences.en: There's never like, oh, but I'm going to miss you so much.
sentences.zh: 从来不会说，哦，但我会很想你的。

sentences.en: Don't go.
sentences.zh: 别去。

sentences.en: Or if we do say that, we don't mean it.
sentences.zh: 或者即使我们说了，那也不是真心的。

sentences.en: Like, if I'm like, oh, you're going to the gym, he's like, yeah, and I'm like, no, stay in bed.
sentences.zh: 比如，如果我说，哦，你要去健身房吗？他说，是啊。我就说，不，留在床上吧。

sentences.en: And then he's like, do you want me to?
sentences.zh: 然后他会问，你真的希望我留下吗？

sentences.en: And there's like that thing of being like, I will if you really want.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉就是，如果你真的想要，我会留下的。

sentences.en: And I'm like, no, no, no, go.
sentences.zh: 然后我说，不不不，你去吧。

sentences.en: Like, just having your own things that you do, and not losing that, because it is really easy too.
sentences.zh: 所以，拥有属于自己的事情并坚持下去，不要丢掉自我，因为这真的很容易做到。

sentences.en: Yeah, I agree.
sentences.zh: 是的，我同意。

sentences.en: And I think that the mistake I've made in past relationships is when you spend every waking minute together,
sentences.zh: 我觉得我在过去的关系中犯的错误就是，把每一分钟清醒的时间都花在一起，

sentences.en: every night, especially in those early, that early period, like where you, that's like where all the bonding happens.
sentences.zh: 尤其是每天晚上，特别是在那段早期阶段，那是所有感情升温发生的时候。

sentences.en: When you conflate all of that oxytocin and that dopamine with the other person's presence, you become codependent.
sentences.zh: 当你把所有的催产素和多巴胺都与对方的存在挂钩时，你就会产生依赖心理。

sentences.en: But additionally, all of that time and all of that codependency, I honestly think just speeds up the timeline of the relationship if it's not the right one.
sentences.zh: 而且，所有这些时间和依赖感，老实说，如果这段关系不是对的那一个，只会加速它的终结。
百分之百。

sentences.en: It puts it under so much pressure because you need time to breathe.
sentences.zh: 这会给关系带来巨大的压力，因为你需要空间来喘息。

sentences.en: You need time to receive stimulation from your friends, from your family, from your hobbies.
sentences.zh: 你需要时间从朋友、家人和爱好中获得刺激。

sentences.en: And when you don't allow the relationship to breathe, when you put it in a pressure cooker and you like almost join your hands together and won't let them go,
sentences.zh: 当你不允许关系有喘息的空间，把它关进高压锅里，几乎要把双手紧紧扣在一起不愿放开时，

sentences.en: all that's going to do is just completely just burn the string out.
sentences.zh: 这只会彻底烧断那根弦。

sentences.en: And you'll be, you'll be done by the end of the week.
sentences.zh: 到周末结束时，你们就完了。

sentences.en: You'll get bored.
sentences.zh: 你会感到厌烦。

sentences.en: You'll get bored.
sentences.zh: 你会感到厌烦。

sentences.en: And you'll start irritating each other.
sentences.zh: 而且你们会开始看对方不顺眼。

sentences.en: Like you will get to like the point that you're just like, the sound of their voice makes me want to cry.
sentences.zh: 你会达到那种程度，觉得对方说话的声音都让你想哭。

sentences.en: And it's, and then as well, you start sitting there and thinking, how did we get here?
sentences.zh: 然后你会坐在那里想，我们是怎么走到这一步的？

sentences.en: Like I was so in love with you.
sentences.zh: 我曾经那么爱你。

sentences.en: How are we here?
sentences.zh: 我们怎么会变成这样？

sentences.en: It's because like you do need to give that breather.
sentences.zh: 这是因为你需要给彼此喘息的机会。

sentences.en: You need to have that time that you're investing in other things because as well, you're the only constant in your own life.
sentences.zh: 你需要投入时间在其他事情上，因为说到底，你才是自己生命中唯一的恒量。

sentences.en: I so agree with that.
sentences.zh: 我非常赞同这一点。

sentences.en: You can't rely on anyone else to be your social life, to be like the one solo person to be your social life, your happiness, your entertainment.
sentences.zh: 你不能指望别人成为你的整个社交圈，成为你唯一的社交、快乐和娱乐来源。

sentences.en: Like you need to be that for yourself.
sentences.zh: 你需要自己去实现这些。

sentences.en: And then you need to pull on multiple resources for that.
sentences.zh: 你需要从多个渠道获取这些能量。

sentences.en: You need to have your friends.
sentences.zh: 你需要有你的朋友。

sentences.en: You need to have your, like, I say work, but when I say work, I mean that thing that fuels you and makes you feel successful.
sentences.zh: 你需要有你的，我说是工作，但我的意思是那些能激励你、让你感到有成就感的事情。

sentences.en: And then your partner can also feed into that.
sentences.zh: 然后你的伴侣也可以为你提供支持。

sentences.en: But it's so important to have those multiple energy sources that isn't just one person because that energy source, if it is just that one person, will run out.
sentences.zh: 但拥有多个能量来源非常重要，不能只依赖一个人，因为如果能量来源只有那一个人，它终会耗尽。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's like draining on both of you.
sentences.zh: 是的，这对你们双方来说都是一种消耗。

sentences.en: And also when you're in a relationship, you're supposed to be growing together, but also individually.
sentences.zh: 而且在一段关系中，你们应该共同成长，但也应该各自成长。

sentences.en: And if you don't each have your own individual things going on, there's nothing new to bring to the relationship.
sentences.zh: 如果你们没有各自独立的生活，那你们之间就没什么新鲜事可分享了。

sentences.en: Like there's no points of conversation.
sentences.zh: 就像没有话题可聊一样。

sentences.en: There's no like, oh, I learned this or I had this experience and sharing that because it's like, oh, wait, you were there.
sentences.zh: 没有那种“哦，我学到了这个”或者“我有了这种经历”的分享，因为对方当时也在场。

sentences.en: So then you just become stagnant.
sentences.zh: 这样你们就会变得停滞不前。

sentences.en: And I think that's bad for both you as an individual, but also the relationship.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这对个人和关系来说都很糟糕。

sentences.en: There's just nowhere to go from there.
sentences.zh: 那样的话，这段关系就无处可去了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I wanted to ask, as you live with your partner, Chris, now, did you have any of those fears of spending so much time together when you first moved in?
sentences.zh: 我想问一下，既然你现在和伴侣Chris住在一起，刚搬到一起时，你会担心花太多时间在一起吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, a little bit.
sentences.zh: 是的，有一点。

sentences.en: So we've lived together for, I think, like six years now, but for the first seven or eight years, I'm bad at maths, of our relationship,
sentences.zh: 我们住在一起大概有六年了，但在我们关系的头七八年里——我不擅长数学——

sentences.en: we were almost in a long distance relationship.
sentences.zh: 我们几乎处于异地恋状态。

sentences.en: Because he lived about an hour and a half away from me when we first started dating.
sentences.zh: 因为刚开始约会时，他住的地方离我有一个半小时的路程。

sentences.en: Then I moved up to Sydney and we lived three hours away.
sentences.zh: 后来我搬到了悉尼，我们住的地方相隔三小时车程。

sentences.en: So we would only get to spend weekends together pretty much.
sentences.zh: 所以我们基本上只能在周末见面。

sentences.en: So to go from that to then living together, I was a little bit concerned.
sentences.zh: 所以从那种状态转变为住在一起，我确实有点担心。

sentences.en: And I also know that I love socializing.
sentences.zh: 而且我知道我喜欢社交。

sentences.en: I love going to gigs.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢去现场演出。

sentences.en: I love to go out and have like a night out with the girls.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢出去和闺蜜们过夜。

sentences.en: Chris doesn't drink.
sentences.zh: Chris不喝酒。

sentences.en: So there's differences in our lifestyles that I was like, okay, this will be interesting.
sentences.zh: 所以我们的生活方式有差异，当时我想，好吧，这会很有趣。

sentences.en: But I really had faith that it was going to be great.
sentences.zh: 但我坚信一切都会很好。

sentences.en: And I was like, this is actually going to be so fun.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这实际上会非常有趣。

sentences.en: It's really going to bring us together.
sentences.zh: 这真的会让我们更亲密。

sentences.en: But a lot of other people were saying, this is going to be a real test for your relationship.
sentences.zh: 但很多人都说，这对你们的关系将是一个真正的考验。

sentences.en: And again, like, I feel like my gut instinct was like, no, this is going to be a good thing.
sentences.zh: 同样，我觉得我的直觉告诉我，不，这会是一件好事。

sentences.en: Like, we've been dating for many years by this point.
sentences.zh: 毕竟我们那时已经约会很多年了。

sentences.en: Like, I would hope that I know him well enough that I think this is going to work.
sentences.zh: 我希望我足够了解他，觉得这行得通。

sentences.en: And it did.
sentences.zh: 结果确实如此。

sentences.en: Like, I think, and I think it's because we have maintained those like separations in our lives.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是因为我们保持了生活中那些独立的部分。

sentences.en: So, you know, he has his own group of friends that he'll hang out with.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，他有他自己的朋友圈，会和他们出去玩。

sentences.en: We have our own hobbies.
sentences.zh: 我们有各自的爱好。

sentences.en: We have both very different careers, but are both very supportive of each other's work lives.
sentences.zh: 我们的职业非常不同，但我们都非常支持对方的工作。

sentences.en: And are still like best friends at the end of the day also.
sentences.zh: 而且归根结底，我们仍然是最好的朋友。

sentences.en: And we have a lot of fun together.
sentences.zh: 我们在一起有很多乐趣。

sentences.en: And I think that's the thing is we have like joy and laughter every single day that we will go one day without each other.
sentences.zh: 我觉得关键在于，我们每天都有快乐和欢笑，即使有一天我们不在一起。

sentences.en: And I like am genuinely so excited to go home and see him.
sentences.zh: 我真的非常期待回家见到他。

sentences.en: That's so amazing.
sentences.zh: 那太棒了。

sentences.en: I think one thing as well that like we both do in our relationships is we are not constantly talking throughout the day.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们俩在关系中做的另一件事是，我们不会整天不停地聊天。

sentences.en: Like, we'll have like a few texts maybe of communication with our partners through the day.
sentences.zh: 我们可能一天只会给对方发几条信息。

sentences.en: Or sometimes we don't talk to them at all.
sentences.zh: 或者有时我们根本不联系。

sentences.en: But it's like there is no constant thread of communication throughout the whole day.
sentences.zh: 但不会整天保持那种持续不断的沟通。

sentences.en: Especially if you live together.
sentences.zh: 特别是如果你住在一起的话。

sentences.en: That's so much because then you do see each other and you're like, oh, so what is, what are we talking about?
sentences.zh: 那太频繁了，因为当你见到对方时，你会想，哦，那我们聊什么呢？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because I've already told you everything the second it's happening.
sentences.zh: 因为事情发生的那一刻，我已经全都告诉你了。

sentences.en: That like constant texting, constant need to like call every hour and check in and talk about what's happening in your day like isn't healthy.
sentences.zh: 那种持续不断的短信，每小时都要打电话确认、聊一天发生的事情，是不健康的。

sentences.en: Because what is there, what more do you have?
sentences.zh: 因为除此之外，你们还有什么呢？

sentences.en: Or if you're watching every single TV show together or doing every single hobby together, you've got nothing to like, you're like, oh, I watch this really cool movie.
sentences.zh: 或者如果你和对方一起看每一部电视剧，一起做每一个爱好，你就没什么可分享的了，你会说，哦，我看了这部很酷的电影。

sentences.en: Oh, you watched it too.
sentences.zh: 哦，你也看了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Like you've gotten, there's no spice.
sentences.zh: 就像那样，生活失去了情趣。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And just no time to enjoy things on your own and what you like.
sentences.zh: 而且没有时间去享受你自己喜欢的东西。

sentences.en: You'll just end up watching Wolf of Wall Street.
sentences.zh: 最后你们只会一起看《华尔街之狼》。

sentences.en: Well, American Psycho.
sentences.zh: 或者《美国精神病人》。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it's like those points of difference, right?
sentences.zh: 这就是差异带来的意义，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, and I love what you said before about almost diversifying your portfolio, your life portfolio.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢你之前说的关于多元化你的投资组合，也就是你的生活组合。

sentences.en: Because I do think that there's a tendency that I've seen in myself and amongst friends where a new love interest enters, suddenly 60% carped off to them.
sentences.zh: 因为我确实发现，我自己和身边的朋友都有这种倾向，当新的恋情出现时，突然间60%的时间都被对方占据了。

sentences.en: And it's natural to be obsessed.
sentences.zh: 沉迷其中是很自然的。

sentences.en: It's natural to have all of that, all of those things like rushing in your brain and rushing through your body and like pulling you towards that person.
sentences.zh: 大脑中涌现出所有那些东西，在体内奔涌，把你拉向那个人，这很自然。

sentences.en: But the big thing that I think often loses out is our friendships.
sentences.zh: 但我认为最容易被牺牲掉的大事是我们的友谊。

sentences.en: I think that is the first thing to go because you need work for money.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那是第一件被放弃的事情，因为你需要工作来赚钱。

sentences.en: I think hobbies are another one that sometimes we let go of pretty quickly.
sentences.zh: 我觉得爱好是另一件我们有时会很快放弃的事情。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But I do think that we have a dedicated like social time and sometimes we see social time as like romantic time and they take from each other.
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为，我们有专门的社交时间，有时我们把社交时间看作浪漫时间，它们会相互挤占。

sentences.en: So how did you, either of you can answer this question.
sentences.zh: 那么你们是怎么做的？你们谁都可以回答这个问题。

sentences.en: Like, would you have any advice for how to maintain healthy, good friendships whilst in a relationship, especially in those early days?
sentences.zh: 比如，对于如何在恋爱中，特别是在早期阶段，维持健康良好的友谊，你们有什么建议吗？

sentences.en: Because I think it's the worst thing to spend the first six months obsessed with someone, wake up, things aren't going great and you don't have any friends.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得最糟糕的事情就是，头六个月沉迷于某人，醒悟过来后发现一切并不顺利，而你已经没有朋友了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I think at the start and by at the start, I'm talking like the first month.
sentences.zh: 我觉得在开始阶段，我指的是第一个月。

sentences.en: I think it's okay to be like completely infatuated with the person.
sentences.zh: 我觉得对一个人完全着迷是可以的。

sentences.en: I think your friends, especially good ones, will sit there and watch and be like, love this for you.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你的朋友，尤其是好朋友，会坐在那里看着，说，真为你高兴。

sentences.en: Because they've also probably been there while you're dating, absolute trash and they're like, please don't get back with your ex.
sentences.zh: 因为她们可能也经历过你约会那些烂人的时候，她们会说，求你别再和你前任复合了。

sentences.en: So when you actually meet someone good, they're like, yeah, stick, stick, stick, it's good, stay there, don't self-sabotage.
sentences.zh: 所以当你真的遇到一个好人时，她们会说，好，坚持住，坚持住，这很好，待在那里，别自我破坏。

sentences.en: This is an autobiographical conversation.
sentences.zh: 这是一段自传式的对话。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So I think it's actually okay to be guiltless about falling in love.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，坠入爱河时不必感到内疚。

sentences.en: I think you shouldn't have to stress yourself out about being like, I've met this person, I really want to spend time with them this weekend.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你不应该因为想和刚认识的人共度周末而感到压力。

sentences.en: But I don't know, do I have to see like the girls, like blah, blah, blah.
sentences.zh: 但我不知道，我是不是必须去见闺蜜，诸如此类的。

sentences.en: That's okay.
sentences.zh: 没关系的。

sentences.en: You can do that.
sentences.zh: 你可以那样做。

sentences.en: But once, you know, after a month, you definitely need to make sure that you're investing in your friendships in that month.
sentences.zh: 但一个月后，你一定要确保在那一个月里你也在投资你的友谊。

sentences.en: Also don't fall off the face of the earth.
sentences.zh: 还有，不要从地球上消失。

sentences.en: Like keep up communications and don't just speak about yourself.
sentences.zh: 保持联系，不要只谈论你自己。

sentences.en: Don't just speak about how happy you are and how amazing things are.
sentences.zh: 不要只谈论你有多幸福，事情有多棒。

sentences.en: Definitely speak to it.
sentences.zh: 当然可以谈论这些。

sentences.en: But not only about that, make sure that you're asking and investing in your friends' lives as well.
sentences.zh: 但不仅限于这些，也要确保去询问和关心朋友们的生活。

sentences.en: I think what I've like, I've actually kind of found it a lot simpler in this relationship than others because I like missing my partner.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我实际上发现这段关系比其他的要简单得多，因为我喜欢想念我的伴侣。

sentences.en: I like having time away and building that.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢有分开的时间，并建立那种空间。

sentences.en: And it is hard because when you are completely infatuated and you're like, I just want to spend every second with you.
sentences.zh: 这确实很难，因为当你完全着迷时，你会想，我只想和你每分每秒都待在一起。

sentences.en: But I've burned that bridge before.
sentences.zh: 但我以前也曾把路走绝过。

sentences.en: Like I've done that and I'm like, I know I don't want that.
sentences.zh: 就像我以前那样，当时我就想，我知道我不想要那种生活。

sentences.en: Plus, I'm also infatuated with my friends.
sentences.zh: 再说，我也很迷恋我的朋友们。

sentences.en: So I think having that, those really good quality friends that you do genuinely feed off and want to see and booking in those times.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，拥有那些你真心能从中汲取能量、真心想见面的优质好友，并把和她们相聚的时间排进日程，这一点很重要。

sentences.en: Like have the girls night that you're like, oh my God, I saw this really cool bar.
sentences.zh: 比如组织一次闺蜜之夜，你会说，天哪，我发现了一家超棒的酒吧。

sentences.en: Let's all go on Friday and go.
sentences.zh: 我们周五一起去吧。

sentences.en: You're going on Friday and it's not a chore.
sentences.zh: 周五去的时候，这不会是一种负担。

sentences.en: You're not like, oh, I've got to go see my friends.
sentences.zh: 你不会觉得，噢，我不得不去见我的朋友们。

sentences.en: If you feel like that, maybe that's something to investigate further.
sentences.zh: 如果你有这种感觉，也许你应该深入探究一下原因。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's not the relationship's fault.
sentences.zh: 没错，这不是恋爱关系的错。
